summary: XOMA Royalty Corp filed an 8-K announcing the expected closing of its acquisition by Ligand Pharmaceuticals, originally disclosed April 27, 2026 and amended May 16, 2026. Closing is on or about July 14, 2026, subject to satisfaction of remaining conditions. Separately, XOMA delivered notices to redeem its Series A and Series B Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock in connection with the merger. The transaction is structured as a merger with Flex Merger Sub, Inc. Terms such as price per share, premium, and deal value were not restated in this filing. Watch for regulatory clearance and the July closing date as risk-arb events, with redemption mechanics signaling deal certainty.
